selection_history: Prior results and review known; no new confirmatory or first-of-kind claim.
baseline_definition: At least one class 2/3 and all five class 1/2/3 observations in 2000-2004. Future class labels do not define that reference. Complete-year and available-year variants are reported separately.
available_year_rule: Coverage >=95%; missing area retained with source-class lower/upper bounds; observed-area-normalized response is explicitly conditional on observed support.
response: Separate logit seasonal/permanent source-class fractions; no summing separately modeled shares. Source-class area trends also reported.

inference.interval_scope: Pointwise, exploratory, approximate; bootstrap conditions on fixed covariates.
inference.multiplicity: BY across six district x source-class tests within each cohort/model; union descriptive.

validation.scope: Conditional chronological hindcast on frozen cohorts; not independent classification accuracy.

influence: All 22 leave-one-year-out fits, not selective exclusion of 2012. 2013-2021 sensitivity restricted to trend and monsoon specifications.

window_changes.scope: All reported; no preferred favorable window.

calendar_matching: For each calendar month intersect valid monthly pixels across all 22 years within the baseline reference; report support and only fit if >=20% reference retention. This monthly outcome does not recreate the annual JRC class.
radar: Seasonal support first. Audit native scores, daily/monthly compositing, date counts and coarse-cell gates. New paired confusion cells if authenticated access permits; retain unsupported states.

detectability.scope: Explicitly simulated perturbations, separate from real observations; no synthetic gap filling. Preserve real support/method-envelope widths and dates.

external_references: Require georeferenced human/field labels, acquisition dates, license and study-area overlap. Do not reuse assisted labels or automated products as independent truth. Report geographic/temporal ineligibility rather than inventing labels.
context: River corridors and temporally declared land-cover context allowed; no backcasting a 2020 crop map to 2000 or inferring pumping causality. Modeled streamflow cannot be described as observed gauge discharge.
permissions: Read actual local/public data; authenticated existing services if available; no paid upgrades, account creation, disclosure of credentials, journal submission, emails, authorship invention or public exposure.
output_policy: New run and revised package only; raw files, original labels and prior manuscript remain unchanged. No publication/100% accuracy guarantee.
